metaTitle: Custom Direct to Film Products | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom direct to film products for vibrant, durable branding. Perfect for bulk orders at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Direct to Film (DTF) printing produces vibrant, detailed designs on a wide range of fabric types, from cotton to polyester blends. Unlike traditional screen printing, DTF transfers full-color artwork without color limitations or setup fees, making it ideal for short runs, multi-color logos, and all-over prints. For safety managers ordering uniforms or marketing directors creating event giveaways, DTF offers fast turnaround and excellent wash durability. Choose custom direct to film products for your next corporate order.
heroAltText: Custom direct to film products featuring a full-color logo on a polyester performance shirt
